locator.title: Топ-6 нестандартных планировок квартир от Level Group
locator.lead: Покажем несколько вариантов в разных районах Москвы
locator.caption: Пример гардеробной на плане квартиры — при желании в ней можно хранить сезонные вещи

nearest_text_after.text: 🔥 В премиальной коллекции квартир от Level вы найдёте просторные квартиры, которые сможете превратить в пространство своей мечты: уютный вариант с несколькими детскими, минималистичный островок спокойствия с отдельной рабочей зоной или центр притяжения семьи, где собираются все близкие. И всё это в любом районе Москвы, даже в центре. Выбирайте, что вам нравится, и не бойтесь экспериментировать: места хватит даже для нестандартных решений.

image_reading: A top-down architectural apartment plan with room areas, furnishings, doors, and thick dark exterior walls.
A bold black arrow is already visible, angled downward toward the compact central room labelled 3.9.
The plan is a static graphic, so motion should be limited to the existing arrow and a subtle optical emphasis without changing labels or layout.
analysis.article_context: Article-body floor plan illustrating how a dedicated walk-in closet/storage room can organize household belongings; the existing black arrow directs attention to the 3.9 m² central closet area.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The plan shows that a dedicated closet is a practical, integrated part of a spacious apartment layout.
structured_intent.primary_action: The existing directional arrow moves smoothly to emphasize the central closet room.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The black arrow is visibly settled with its tip pointing at the room labelled 3.9, with a subtle emphasis inside it.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The apartment plan remains an accurate, unchanged architectural layout centered on organized storage.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, keep the floor plan and camera completely fixed. The existing black arrow begins a small, smooth downward glide along its visible diagonal toward the 3.9 room, then eases into its original pointing position. A subtle contained glow gathers in that room as the arrow arrives; the final frames hold the clearly aimed arrow and quiet glow.
models.positive_prompt: The existing black arrow glides gently downward along its current diagonal and settles with its tip precisely on the 3.9 closet room; a restrained soft glow briefly concentrates there, ending with the arrow clearly pointing to the room. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, use a fixed full-plan view. Let the existing arrow make one measured diagonal downward movement, developing through most of the shot and easing to a stop at the 3.9 closet. A light optical emphasis blooms softly within the indicated room only as the arrow settles, leaving the plan unchanged and the endpoint readable.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed view of the floor plan. The existing black arrow smoothly traces its short downward path toward the 3.9 closet room, ending precisely aimed at it as a subtle soft highlight settles inside the room.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, retain the stationary architectural plan. Animate only the existing black arrow in one concise, even downward glide along its present diagonal, reaching the 3.9 room near the end. Add a minimal soft highlight inside that existing room as the arrow comes to rest, with the final frame clearly emphasizing the closet.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the floor plan. The existing black arrow makes a short smooth downward glide to the 3.9 closet room, ending clearly aimed at the room with a gentle contained highlight there.
